title: Artificial Intelligence in Pediatric Urology: Accuracy and Consistency of ChatGPT's Responses on Hypospadias

live_model.evidence: "Each question was entered sequentially into ChatGPT (GPT-4-turbo, OpenAI) ... All questions were submitted to ChatGPT (GPT-4-turbo, OpenAI) between March 1 and March 15, 2025, using separate browser sessions" (Methods)

prompt.location: Methods (question curation/categorization described; individual questions not all quoted)
prompt.note: Each question asked twice via separate browser sessions/devices for reproducibility scoring.

claim.metric: 4-point expert rating scale score (1=Completely correct ... 4=Completely incorrect), pooled across hypospadias questions

data.source: Author-curated clinical questions based on AUA/EAU hypospadias guidelines; not released as a dataset

notes: Explicitly uses the ChatGPT web interface via separate browser sessions (not the API), and grading is a subjective 1-4 expert rating rather than an automatically-checkable numeric answer.
